content: Compatibility of UnresolvedReferenceRestriction- WithSeverity For an existing reference attribute, the UnresolvedReferenceRestrictionWith- Severity defines the severity , if the given reference path cannot be resolved. An interoperability problem exists if the UnresolvedReferenceRestriction- WithSeverity . severity on the producer side is lower than the Unresolve- dReferenceRestrictionWithSeverity . severity on the consumer side.
